name: FeaturedCustomers

sources.title: For Vendors — free Verified Vendor profile vs Premium Vendor upgrade; Add Your Company / Verify Your Profile / Upgrade forms

requirements: B2B business software or service vendors only — the platform is a customer-reference directory (reviews, case studies, success stories, testimonials, videos)
Free 'Verified Vendor' profile includes updating company info, managing branding, sample customer references, and consideration for Customer Success Reports
'Add Your Company' is a contact form (name, company, email, phone) — the team follows up; it says 'Contact us today for pricing options' for adding customer references
preparation: Company name, business email, phone number for the contact form
Company info and branding assets (logo, description) for the verified profile
Customer references/case studies if you want the profile to carry content
workflow: Choose the free path: 'Get Verified for Free' (claim/verify an existing profile) or 'Add Your Company' (new company) — both open contact forms
Submit the form (First/Last name, Company, Email, Phone) and wait for a service specialist to respond
Complete verification to take control of the profile, then update company info and branding
watchFor: Not an instant self-serve listing — every path funnels into a contact form followed by human follow-up
'Add your company' page mentions 'pricing options' — references/content features may be gated behind Premium even though basic verification is free
Premium Vendor upgrade sells competitor-info removal, multi-category placement, unlimited references, profile analytics
Platform is about customer references — a vendor profile with no customer success content has limited value
countsAsLive: A public vendor profile page exists on featuredcustomers.com under a software/service category and shows as verified/managed
unknowns: Whether a free Verified Vendor profile is always granted or depends on existing customer references on the platform
Whether outbound links from the profile are dofollow
Turnaround time after the contact form
